draft.subject: Photographing the Boreal Quartet at Metro Concert Hall.
draft.body: It was good connecting about the Boreal Quartet at Metro Concert Hall on July 12. I shoot unobtrusive documentary coverage with no flash, so the audience doesn't notice me and the performance isn't disturbed, and nearly ten years of that has been at Carnegie Hall. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one hour minimum, with the edited gallery back within two weeks. I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the evening. I look forward to hearing from you.
